title: Anomalous rate of eigenstate thermalisation at singularities of the density of states
summary: We prove the Eigenstate Thermalisation Hypothesis (ETH), also known as Quantum Unique Ergodicity (QUE), for large $N\times N$ mean-field random matrices with general correlation structure. We identify the microcanonical ensemble and establish the optimal fluctuation scale of eigenvector overlaps around it. Our results invalidate the inverse-density scaling predicted by Feingold and Peres [Phys. Rev. A 34, 591 (1986)] (and incorporated into Srednicki's ansatz [Phys. Rev.
